cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm Gillian Seed. I've been assigned to JUNKER as of today.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Mr. Gillian Seed. My apologies.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Mr. Seed.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Just Gillian, Mika. Call me Gillian.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: All right, Gillian. I'll open the door to HQ.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I'll show you around inside.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Oh, right. The Chief asked me to show you around when you arrived.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: The Chief?

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: The head of JUNKER HQ. He's through that door.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Chief, I've brought Mr. Gillian Seed.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Welcome, Gillian Seed. I'm Benson Cunningham, Chief of JUNKER HQ.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I'm Gillian Seed, from the 17th Special Forces Unit.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Seed, I've heard how well you did in special military training.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: I want you to put those talents to work on this assignment.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Your file says you have amnesia. Has your memory returned?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: That's right. The military found me three years ago.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I remember nothing from before that.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: You had a wife, didn't you?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Yes, but we're separated now. Neither of us has any memories.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: How could we make it work?

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: I can imagine.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: You should understand your assignment now.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: I see. Like a police badge.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: It's not much, but here's money for your investigation expenses.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Cash?

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Cards only work in certain areas. You'll definitely need cash.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Sounds like a rough city.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: Get your JUNKER equipment from Harry, our mechanic.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: I'm Mika Slayton, JUNKER HQ's receptionist and operator.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Nice to meet you.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Oh, Harry's back.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Welcome. You're Gillian Seed?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Have we met somewhere?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: No, this is the first time.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Then I must be imagining it.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Oh, right. Don't rush me. I've got it ready.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: This is the Blaster, a JUNKER's weapon. It has a feedback system.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: It responds to the speed of your reflexes.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: The Blaster's performance depends on who's using it.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Go on, hold it.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: It's light.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Isn't it? Nothing like the ray guns the military uses.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Super engineering plastic, carbon fiber and ceramic.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: So temperature changes won't affect it.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: It's ergonomically designed for function and firepower.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Well, do you like it?

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Not bad.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I know. Shall we call the Navigator I built just for you?

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Hey, Metal Gear!

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Metal, introduce yourself.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Gillian, I'm Metal Gear Mk. II. Nice to meet you.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: Metal Gear? Strange name.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: He's cute.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: He's blushing.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: I based his shape on Metal Gear, the machine

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: that terrified the world at the end of the twentieth century.

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: But this one was developed for peaceful use.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Jean Jack Gibson is calling. I'll put him through.

cues.speaker: Gibson
cues.en: JUNKER HQ! I've cornered a suspected Snatcher!

cues.speaker: Gibson
cues.en: Factory ruins, District M. Send backup now!

cues.speaker: Harry
cues.en: Gillian, we've got a case! Get to the scene!

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: Let's hurry. We'll take the Tricycle to the scene.

cues.speaker: Mika
cues.en: Be careful, Gillian.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: This is the Tricycle, a vehicle for JUNKER use only.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It can drive on three wheels, hover and fly at high speed.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: It's a VTOL, so it can take off vertically even in tight spaces.

cues.speaker: Gillian
cues.en: A flying tricycle, right? One picked me up earlier.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We'll use this Tricycle for investigations.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: You can now save your investigation progress. Just ask me anytime.

cues.speaker: Metal Gear
cues.en: We're heading to the factory ruins.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: This is your JUNKER card. It identifies you as a JUNKER.

cues.speaker: Chief
cues.en: It grants you a JUNKER's special authority.
My first day, and already a case.
Gibson, an ace JUNKER, has cornered a suspected Snatcher.
Is the man really a Snatcher? And what are Snatchers?
